disease_label_per_paper: Septic abortion secondary to Peptoniphilus asaccharolyticus complicated by bacteremia
presentation_summary: 36-year-old woman with asthma, gravida 8 para 5+2, presented to the ED with one day of fever to 39 C at home, chills, and vaginal bleeding.
One week earlier she had been admitted for incomplete abortion at 14 weeks gestation, received misoprostol 600 mcg once, and was discharged in stable condition.
ED vital signs showed blood pressure 115/77 mmHg, heart rate 101/min, respiratory rate 20/min, and oxygen saturation 100% on room air.
Abdominal examination showed a soft abdomen with mild suprapubic tenderness.
Speculum exam showed blood in the vagina but no active cervical bleeding.

Labs showed hemoglobin 8 g/dL, WBC 13 x10^9/L with neutrophilic shift, neutrophil count 9 x10^9/L, platelets 462 x10^9/L, CRP 108 mg/L, procalcitonin 0.08 mcg/L, creatinine 39 umol/L, and urinalysis negative for nitrite and leukocyte esterase.
Urgent transvaginal ultrasound showed retained products of conception.

Recent incomplete abortion, fever/chills, vaginal bleeding, suprapubic tenderness, inflammatory labs, and RPOC ultrasound are ranking evidence.
